Our story

Built for
the pitch

Shah Sports was founded in 2020 by Tahir Ali Shah — a passionate hockey player who has lived in Poland since 2016, playing for Polonia Skierniewice Hockey Club and previously representing UEHC Hockey Dubai. He coaches youth players and understands exactly what athletes at every level need from their equipment.

In 2022, Ata Rajput joined as co-founder, bringing the commercial and legal infrastructure to take Shah Sports from a promising brand to an internationally recognised equipment supplier. Shah Sports became official supplier to six European national federations within two years of that partnership.

Together, Tahir brings the product expertise and athlete relationships, while Ata brings the international commercial architecture that allows Shah Sports to operate and grow across borders.

The team

The people
behind Shah Sports

🏈
Tahir Ali Shah
Founder & CEO

Hockey player, coach, and entrepreneur. Based in Poland since 2016, playing for Polonia Skierniewice and previously representing UEHC Hockey Dubai. Tahir identified the gap between what elite European players needed and what the market was offering — and built Shah Sports to close it. He leads product development, player relationships, and national team partnerships.

🌐
Ata Rajput
Co-Founder & Commercial Director

International lawyer and cross-border business specialist with over 12 years of experience across 30+ jurisdictions spanning Europe, MENA, and beyond. Fluent in five languages. Background in international trade, supply chain structuring, and cross-border commercial agreements with clubs, federations, and government bodies. Ata built the legal and commercial framework that enabled Shah Sports to operate as an international supplier — handling federation contracts, EU compliance, and wholesale partnerships at scale.

What we stand for

Shah Values

🏈

Performance first

Every product is designed by players for players. We don't make equipment for showrooms — we make it for pitches, in every weather, at every level of the game.

⚖️

Fair pricing

We manufacture in Sialkot, Pakistan — the world's hockey equipment capital. We cut the middlemen and pass the savings directly to players and clubs across Europe.

🎍

Community driven

We sponsor youth clubs, national teams, and individual talents. Hockey grows when players at all levels can access quality equipment without paying premium retail prices.
